discovery_notes: Cell B079 BoxLunch 2022 (any maker). 29 standard searches, snippets only; Disney Pins Blog posts plus BoxLunch listings and one mall-hosted BoxLunch listing. No prior lic/2022 BoxLunch keys existed. Maker from listing titles (Loungefly, Uncas International) else boxlunch-only key. Blind boxes (Alice characters, Pumpkin, Fruit June, Princess Signature, Avengers, WDW 50 map) recorded as sets only with members held. Up trio set held for pin structure. Probable listing-to-blog matches flagged in not_found. No 2022 Funko BoxLunch pins confirmed.
